text:
anya: Heads-up — customer onboarding stuck: async Python SDK fails TLS when going through corporate proxy + custom CA. Sync example works.

tom: can you share env + minimal snippet?

anya: short repro: REDWOOD_BASE_URL=https://dedicated-us.redwood.local, HTTP_PROXY=http://proxy.corp:8080, REDWOOD_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/corp-root.pem. Using docs async snippet:
```
from redwood import AsyncClient
client = AsyncClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'), base_url=os.getenv('REDWOOD_BASE_URL'))
await client.chat.completions.create(model='gpt-4-redwood', input='hi')
```
error: httpx SSLError on handshake: "[SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED]" only when proxy env is present.

raj: this smells like httpx/httpcore proxy-tunnel path dropping verify/cafile. We historically only plumb REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE through sync requests client. Async path needs explicit ssl.SSLContext or httpx.Transport verify arg.

gina: quick workaround that worked for me in a customer container: set SSL_CERT_FILE env var to the PEM file BEFORE importing httpx/redwood SDK. e.g. `export SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/corp-root.pem` then start app. httpx will pick it up. Not ideal but unblocks.

tom: another workaround: construct an AsyncClient with a custom transport using aiohttp connector with ssl ctx, then pass to httpx transport wrapper. verbose but explicit.

anya: customer can't change host environment, so need SDK change. Could we add a `ca_bundle` / `ssl_context` param to AsyncClient ctor?

raj: yes — proposal: add ca_bundle: str | None and ssl_context: ssl.SSLContext | None to both Client and AsyncClient. If provided, prefer ssl_context, then ca_bundle, then env vars. Also keep backward-compatible handling of `verify` used by older code (bool or path).

gina: +1. Also fix precedence docs: param > REDWOOD_* env vars > SSL_CERT_FILE/REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE default. Document proxy interplay: when HTTP_PROXY present SDK must preserve verify flags when creating proxy tunnel.

tom: tests: add unit that uses a mock proxy that returns CONNECT and then server cert signed by test CA. Also add integration CI job that runs a tiny mitmproxy container and attempts both sync/async flows.

anya: small UX request: include a short snippet in Dedicated onboarding that shows three patterns: env var, explicit ca_bundle string, and passing ssl_context. Many customers are confused which env var to set.

ci-bot: CI queued: redwood-python#3831 (draft) :arrow_up_small:

raj: implementation notes: careful with typing stubs — stdlib ssl.SSLContext isn't serializable in JSON stubs, but clients in IDE need overloads. Add overloads in typeshed-friendly style and update docs in README.

tom: I'll volunteer to pair on tests for httpx versions. We should test against httpx 0.24 and 0.26 ranges.

gina: also filed a small bug: when REDWOOD_BASE_URL is set and base_url param is provided, SDK sometimes prefers env var if proxy present. We'll make param precedence explicit and add a regression test.

anya: thanks. Please link PR here when opened — blocking customer rollout otherwise.

ci-bot: PR redwood-python/pull/3831 opened (draft) by @gina — includes ca_bundle + ssl_context, tests, and docs updates. :pullrequest:

anya: perfect, will try the draft tomorrow and report back. :pray:
